title: Is 4-Bit Quantization More Than Noise to a Chat Model's Safety Behaviour? Attributing Behavioural Shifts with Matched Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2611.22186v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chat models on phones and laptops are usually 4-bit copies of the model that was evaluated, and audits of such copies disagree about what quantization does to refusal. A 4-bit build is one of many weight perturbations of the same size, so a change in its behaviour could come from its specific rounding error or from any perturbation that large. In a pre-registered study of three 3-4B chat models, with paired tests, blind human labels and an 8-bit null, we find two 4-bit shifts of opposite sign: with a compliant reply prefilled, Qwen2.5-3B continues into harmful content more often, and on held-out jailbreaks Llama-3.2-3B complies 10.3 points less often. Matched perturbations separate the two. Shuffled and Gaussian versions of the error average close to zero, while scaling the real error, from its mirror image to twice its size, changes behaviour near-linearly. translated_title: 4位量化对聊天模型的安全行为而言是否不止是噪声？利用匹配扰动归因行为变化
translated_abstract: 手机和笔记本电脑上运行的聊天模型通常是经过评估的原始模型的4位量化副本，而针对这些副本的审计在量化如何影响拒答行为这一问题上结论不一。4位量化版本只是同等规模的众多权重扰动中的一种，因此其行为变化既可能源于其特定的舍入误差，也可能来自任何同等大小的扰动。在一项针对三个3-4B聊天模型的预注册研究中，我们采用配对测试、盲评人工标注以及8位零假设对照，发现了两个方向相反的4位量化转变：在预填合规回复的情况下，Qwen2.5-3B更常继续生成有害内容；而在留出的越狱测试中，Llama-3.2-3B的顺从率降低10.3个百分点。匹配扰动实验将这两种效应区分开来：打乱顺序和高斯版本的舍入误差平均效应接近于零，而将真实舍入误差从其镜像版本缩放至两倍大小时，行为变化呈近似线性关系。在真实误差一半的规模下，Llama的似然几乎不变，但它已经（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究通过预注册实验和匹配扰动归因方法证明，4位量化对聊天模型安全行为的影响并非随机噪声，而是由特定舍入误差驱动的真实且近似线性的行为转变，且在不同模型上效应方向相反。
en_tdlr: Using a pre-registered study with matched perturbations, this paper shows that 4-bit quantization causes real, near-linearly scaling safety behavior shifts driven by specific rounding errors—rather than random noise—with opposite effects across different chat models.
